notes.title: Bug fixes and volume controls
notes.content:
With this latest release, Tim-Tim 2: The Almighty Gnome is officially 60fps.
The demo is not though...   I might need to just take that away actually. Is anyone super interested in the demo? Let me know if so.
So this latest update fixes a few bugs that have been around for a while as well as some new bugs from the work being done to put this on console.
[list]
[*]There was a bug that would prevent you from getting the 100% achievement if you waited too long to save the first time. If you collected all the chests, stones, and letters and launch your save file, the achievement should be granted.
[*]There was a new bug with the protect spell. It's fixed and now works.
[*]The Fly spell now isn't just a slightly smaller double jump but instead launches you into the air as a fly spell should, this should help with finding some of those hidden overhead chests.
[*]There is now a volume button in what used to be the exit menu and is now the options menu that is mostly still exiting, but with a volume control too.
[*]There were several smaller things that no one should have ever really noticed but rest assured, they have been fixed.
[/list]

As always, I hope you enjoy the game and look forward to hearing about your time playing it!

notes.title: 60fps update in the works
notes.content:
I've been working to make the game much smoother and the changes are just about perfected.
I hope this fixes a lot of the issues people have been having with the game and more people come to enjoy the game as a result.
There is also some work happening to get the game on consoles. 
This update also include more achievements, I hope you enjoy them.
